The store was Pine Crossing, and I've replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team.

The answer comes from her own 9 June message in that channel. She wrote that the morning receiver at Pine Crossing said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver had arrived at 7:10 and staff wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem using the store's login.

Neither the channel nor the shared files say the problem was fixed, so I suggested she check with Hollis before marking it resolved on the account sheet.
